attempts.url: no vendor OpenAPI; the Gemini API publishes a Discovery document

notes: Full coverage of the Gemini API (generativelanguage v1beta), converted from the verbatim Google API Discovery document committed as upstream.json. The conversion is 1:1: every one of the 85 resource methods and all 221 Discovery schemas is modelled (85 operations, 221 components out) — models, generateContent/streamGenerateContent, embedContent, tunedModels, cachedContents, files, corpora, batches and dynamic retrieval. v1beta is the version Google publishes a Discovery doc for and the one the adaptor targets. The gemini adaptor calls this API through the Google SDK; the whole API is described here (not just prompt/deepResearch/generateImage) so a workflow can reach any endpoint. Replaces a 6.6 KiB hand-authored spec.
